changes.comment: Promote DetailedResult from @beta to @public. It has not been genuinely beta since 5.0, and the tag was the only thing making DetailedResult-returning APIs costly for consumers: any @public signature referencing it baked an ae-incompatible-release-tags warning into the consuming package's checked-in api.md. Removes 168 such warnings from ts-utils.api.md alone. No runtime change.
